name: magpie-breeze-blue
description: Breeze Blue TTS provider plugin for Magpie: email/password sign-in with auto-renewal for the web session, a paste-once browser login for NAS/Docker, and daily credit check-in
author: LumenMarch

summary.en: Breeze Blue text-to-speech with daily credit check-in. Sign in with email and password (no browser, auto-renewed) or paste a cookie once — works on a NAS or in Docker.
summary.zh: Breeze Blue 文本转语音，附带每日积分自动领取。可直接填邮箱密码登录（不用浏览器、自动续期），装在 NAS / Docker 上同样可用。
